title: docs(adr): ADR-0011 identity-actions addendum records the two SCIM credential actions

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XEjTSxuJNjTpNnjHFg6tJ6G)_

Fixes #31124

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：ADR-0011 的「平台身份动作」附录补记 #31032（PR #31119）新增的两个动作：`sys_scim_connection_credential.mint_scim_credential` 进 H 档（仅人工，无 `ai` 块），`revoke_scim_credential` 进 C 档（暴露给 AI，但必须人工确认）。计数按当前 `main` 的代码树实测重写：已评估动作 61 个、`ai` 块 37 个（H 24 / C 18 / E 19）。另记一笔：`sys_user.list_platform_admins`（PR #29427，2026-11-02 并入）晚于评估、不在任何档内，按「未评估即仅人工」记入「Not assessed」段。
- **为什么改**：这张表是审阅 `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/**` 的人判断「哪些平台身份动作 AI 能跑」的唯一记录（维护者已否决自动检查）。#31119 合入后表少记了一个已暴露的动作。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 ADR 文本，不改任何规则句、不加门禁或测试，不发布任何包（`skip-changeset`）。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md` 一个文件：① 新增的 2026-11-07 amendment 引文块；② H / C 两个列表末尾各加一个名字与计数；③ 「Not assessed」段新增 `list_platform_admins` 一句。
- **两分钟验证**：对照 `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-scim-connection-credential.object.ts`：`mint_scim_credential` 无 `ai` 块，`revoke_scim_credential` 的 `ai` 块是 `exposed: true, requiresConfirmation: true`；`pnpm check:adr-index && pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors` 应为 exit 0。
- **需要你做的**：Tier H（`docs/adr/**`）：席位按 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 复核通过后，由你合并。

## What changes

One file, `docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md`, inside the 2026-10-30 addendum "the platform identity actions an agent may reach". No rule text moves; the lists and the counts do.

- **A dated amendment note** (2026-11-07, #31124), in the form the 2026-10-31 amendment already uses in this addendum: `sys_scim_connection_credential.mint_scim_credential` is assessed **H** (it mints a SCIM bearer credential and answers it once; triage on #31032, comment `6692886264`: "Classify mint as not exposed to AI tools") and `sys_scim_connection_credential.revoke_scim_credential` is assessed **C** (the same triage: "Revoke may be classified on its own merits"; it switches one bearer off, as `sys_api_key.revoke_api_key` does, bounded to that one connection, and hands out no credential and widens no access; no door restores a revoked SCIM credential, so provisioning resumes only by minting a new one — head `f557345434`, from contract review 6710882534). Both shipped in PR #31119, `a794e32c9b` on `main`.
- **H list** 23 → 24 (mint appended); **C list** 17 → 18 (revoke appended); E unchanged at 19.
- **Counts**, re-measured on the tree (below): "59 actions and 36 `ai` blocks (H 23 / C 17 / E 19)" → "61 assessed actions and 37 `ai` blocks (H 24 / C 18 / E 19); the tree holds one more identity action, unassessed (below)". The two sentences that count the declaring actions move 36 → 37 and 35 → 36 (revoke forwards to `/api/v1/auth/admin/scim/revoke-credential`, under `/api/v1/auth/` like the other 35). The historical reading of the 2026-10-30 assessment ("58 actions in 38 blocks") is untouched; the provenance sentence gains "the two `sys_scim_connection_credential` actions came with the 2026-11-07 amendment".
- **Not assessed** gains one sentence: `sys_user.list_platform_admins` (PR #29427, 2026-11-02) postdates the assessment, declares no `ai` block (its own source comment says so), and is unassessed and human-only until a ruling assesses it. It is placed in no bucket: the H test names minting, ownership, sign-in and destruction, and classifying it is a ruling, not a dev's reading.

## Why

The addendum is the only record of which platform `sys_*` identity actions an AI agent may reach: the maintainer struck the automatic check (「自动检查 有必要吗？每一个元数据应用都有类似的问题，后续都要检查吗」), so a reviewer of `identity/**` reads this table and nothing else. After PR #31119 it omitted one live AI-exposed action (revoke, C) and one human-only action (mint, H). The card asked for exactly that addendum entry, blocked on #31119 landing; #31119 merged 2026-11-07T14:04Z.

## Tests

None added, by the card's ruling: the maintainer struck the automatic check for this table, so this PR adds no gate, test or script. The per-action pins on the two actions' `ai` blocks landed with #31119 (`sys-scim-connection-credential-actions.test.ts`) and are not touched.

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's numbers vs the tree.** The card computed H 24 / C 18, 61 actions, 37 `ai` blocks. The tree at `origin/main` `658d84f575` holds **62** actions on the 13 identity objects that declare any, 37 with an `ai` block, 25 without. The 62nd is `sys_user.list_platform_admins` (PR #29427, merged 2026-11-02, after the 2026-10-31 amendment); its source comment reads "No `ai` block: this action postdates the ADR-0011 identity-actions assessment, and an unassessed action stays human-only." The record therefore says 61 assessed (the card's number) and names the unassessed one beside `sys_approval_request`'s 9, rather than silently folding it into H. Whether it should be assessed H (or E, as a read-only roster answer) is a maintainer ruling; named in the report's `open_questions`.
- **Every other name in the three lists resolves to an action on the tree** with the declared bucket (H: no `ai` block; C: `exposed: true, requiresConfirmation: true`; E: `exposed: true`, no confirmation), and no action with an `ai` block is unexposed. Measured by a throwaway script importing `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/index.ts` and reading each `sys_*` object's `actions[].ai`; the script is not committed.
- **No status-line pointer** was added. ADR-0011's `**Status**:` line carries no pointer for the 2026-10-31 amendment either; this addendum's own convention is the dated blockquote, and the card scoped the edit to the lists and counts.
- **Two routes under `/api/v1/auth/admin/scim/`** are plugin-auth's own platform-admin doors (#30991), not better-auth's; the existing sentence "N to the better-auth routes under `/api/v1/auth/`" already counts plugin-auth's `admin/sso/*` and `admin/oauth2/*` doors the same way, so only its number moved. plugin-auth's `scim-connection-admin.ts` header records that an anonymous caller is answered 401 there, which is the behaviour the paragraph describes. Not measured live.
- `docs/adr/README.md` is generated (`pnpm check:adr-index`); nothing in it changes, as no ADR title, status or link moved.

## Verification

All readings at the final head `c53003ae19`: the ADR commit `2096b75721` on `origin/main` `658d84f575`, then one merge of `origin/main` at `de3996bd55` (two commits, #31177 and #31185, touching neither the ADR nor `identity/**`). The 21-gate sweep was run on both heads with the same result; the exit codes below are the final head's.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md`: "Model tier — MANDATORY: claude-fable-5-1 … `docs/adr/**` … effort floor at xhigh". The claim (`6710561423`) records the thread's effort as `high`, a declared deviation with the seat's at-tier contract review as the compensating control.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md`: exit 3, "governed-surface predicate: 1 of 1 path(s) hit the register … ⛔ GOVERNED — a human merge is the review record for this PR".

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (Action names are quoted as declared.)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (eslint ignores `.md`; the derived doc gates pass).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset: this diff publishes nothing (`docs/adr/**` only), `skip-changeset`; both declaration lines are filled in above.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the repo's own Chinese reader section; the maintainer's rulings are quoted verbatim).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
